findings.text: Counting distinct callers across `typeReferences` and `bodyReferences` in the 37,460-constant export gives 2,423 non-internal theorems with zero callers and 1,942 with one caller. Fix: correct the counts or identify the different export and filters that produced the stated values.

The ADR says `.ilean` records each source mention, but `CheckAutoProof.lean` names `FreshEnsures.ifOkWith_iff` in a tactic quotation and its `.ilean` has no reference to that theorem. Fix: define `mention` as a usage recorded by Lean and list names in tactic quotations among the uses the query can miss.

D2 can change a file’s key when a first-party import’s key changes even if the file’s own products stay identical, and option 4(a) also hashes the package manifest. Fix: limit the stated risk to dependency changes that leave every selected key input unchanged.

The recommended snapshot of the test trees includes `SqlFileForms.lean` and `SqlFileErrors.lean`, which both define the root declaration `shop`, so the query’s name-only join and distinct-user count conflate two declarations. Fix: restrict a snapshot to modules with jointly unique kernel names or qualify declaration identities by their defining module throughout the query.

A mention of `Sql.check` inside `failingObservation.visit` falls within the full ranges of both `visit` and `failingObservation`, so containment alone does not identify its user. Fix: use the recorded container when it resolves to an authored declaration and otherwise use the innermost unambiguous authored range.

The specification admits that a successful incremental build can reuse stale SQL products, while ADR D2 says an SQL edit changes the products used to key the snapshot. Fix: require a traced SQL input or verify the compiled SQL source record against disk before accepting the file version.

Rule 3 assumes a shared range identifies one instance, but `deriving instance DecidableEq for ConflictAction, ConflictClause` gives both instances the same `DecidableEq` range. Fix: preserve each registered instance and report any helper whose parent cannot be determined.

Storing only `Inhabited` for `deriving instance Inhabited for Belay.Sqlite.ParseNode` omits the target type and contradicts the owner’s D3 decision to retain the full declaration text. Fix: use the enclosing command’s range for the stored text and let instances from the same command share its text hash.
